title: French airstrike near Bounti reported on January 3, 2021
reason: Armed military/conflict incident, not a public gathering making a demand of Mali’s government.
notes: Tracked to distinguish the airstrike and contested civilian/fighter casualty accounts from protests. Do not count the 40 men/30 alleged fighters or deaths as protest turnout/response, and do not attribute them to the Jan 20 Bamako gathering.

title: CEN-SNESUP strike call over higher-education labor demands
reason: Labor work stoppage/strike, not a documented public gathering of at least 50 people making a demand in a public forum; excluded from protest-event coding on available evidence.
notes: Opened Malijet/Le Républicain reports that the CEN-SNESUP strike began Jan 5 and was called for Jan 5–9; the opened Mali Tribune report says the strike call was lifted Jan 7 after government talks. The planned period was shortened or suspended, and the exact duration/extent remains uncertain. No march, picket or street assembly is documented. Keep the labor action distinct from public protest.
